correctness.rationale: An all-length Euler-trail profile bijection, explicit enumeration of the cyclic-flow parameter and every disconnected 3-vertex case prove the rational generating function. A direct calculation of poles yields the exact least period and degree; source code independently checks the polynomial identity and every candidate 3x3 matrix through nine arcs against all ternary words through ten symbols. Computation corroborates, not replaces, the proof.

value.rationale: The exact size of the entire noiseless ternary read-length-two profile code space is a natural benchmark, not an arbitrary slice. Its degree-six six-period law reflects two-cycle and three-cycle structure and quantifies a sevenfold leading-order excess over the known cyclic unrestricted balanced-matrix counts. This resolves a natural smallest nonbinary case and gives all-length finite counts, not only a numerical table.
